dicentes: Venit contra te multitudo magna de his locis quæ trans mare sunt,

Then Jehoshaphat, being terrified with fear,
totum se contulit ad rogandum Dominum,
gave himself entirely to petitioning the Lord,
and he proclaimed a fast for all of Judah.
Congregatusque est Judas ad deprecandum Dominum:
And Judah gathered together to pray to the Lord.
et omnes de urbibus suis venerunt ad obsecrandum eum.
everyone from their cities came to beseech him.

in domo Domini ante atrium novum,

Omnis vero Juda stabat coram Domino cum parvulis, et uxoribus, et liberis suis.
Truly, all of Judah was standing before the Lord with their little ones and wives and children.
Erat autem Jahaziel filius Zachariæ filii Banaiæ filii Jehiel filii Mathaniæ,
But there was Jahaziel, the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah,
the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah,
super quem factus est spiritus Domini,
a Levite from the sons of Asaph, upon whom the Spirit of the Lord went,
in the midst of the crowd.
and you who live in Jerusalem,
Thus says the Lord to you:
Neither should you be dismayed by this multitude.

and will find them at the summit of the torrent, which is opposite the wilderness of Jeruel.

et videbitis auxilium Domini super vos,

and the Lord will be with you.”

and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell prone on the ground before the Lord,

And he gave counsel to the people.
et statuit cantores Domini ut laudarent eum in turmis suis, et antecederent exercitum,
And he appointed the singing men of the Lord, so that they would praise him by their companies,
and so that they would go before the army,
Confitemini Domino quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
and with one voice say: “Confess to the Lord. For his mercy is eternal.”
And when they had begun to sing praises,
vertit Dominus insidias eorum in semetipsos,
the Lord turned their ambushes upon themselves, that is,
those of the sons of Ammon,
qui egressi fuerant ut pugnarent contra Judam:
who had gone forth so that they might fight against Judah.
Namque filii Ammon et Moab consurrexerunt adversum habitatores montis Seir,
For the sons of Ammon and of Moab rose up against the inhabitants of mount Seir,
so that they might slay and destroy them.
And when they had perpetrated this work,
they cut one another with wounds.
Porro Juda, cum venisset ad speculam quæ respicit solitudinem,
Then, when Judah had gone to the high point that looks out toward the desert,
vidit procul omnem late regionem plenam cadaveribus,
they saw, from far away, the entire wide region filled with dead bodies.
nec superesse quemquam qui necem potuisset evadere.
Neither was there anyone who was left alive and had been able to escape death.
and all the people with him,
in order to take away the spoils of the dead.
And they found, among the dead bodies, diverse equipment,
and very precious vessels. And they despoiled these,
et diripuerunt ita ut omnia portare non possent,
to such an extent that they were unable to carry everything. Neither could they,
nec per tres dies spolia auferre præ prædæ magnitudine.
over three days, take away the spoils because of the magnitude of the plunder.
Die autem quarto congregati sunt in Valle benedictionis:
Then, on the fourth day, they were gathered together in the Valley of Blessing.
For they had blessed the Lord there,
vocaverunt locum illum Vallis benedictionis usque in præsentem diem.
and therefore they called that place the Valley of Blessing, even to the present day.
and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, returned,
eo quod dedisset eis Dominus gaudium de inimicis suis.
For the Lord had granted to them gladness concerning their enemies.
Ingressique sunt in Jerusalem cum psalteriis,
And they entered into Jerusalem with psalteries, and harps,
into the house of the Lord.
Irruit autem pavor Domini super universa regna terrarum cum audissent quod pugnasset Dominus contra inimicos Israël.
Then the fear of the Lord fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands, when they had heard that the Lord had fought against the enemies of Israel.
And the kingdom of Jehoshaphat was quiet.
et præbuit ei Deus pacem per circuitum.
And God granted to him peace on all sides.
And so Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah.
et erat triginta quinque annorum cum regnare cœpisset:
And he was thirty-five years old when he had begun to reign.
Then he reigned for twenty-five years in Jerusalem.
et quinque annis regnavit in Jerusalem,
And the name of his mother was Azubah,
et nomen matris ejus Azuba filia Selahi.
Et ambulavit in via patris suis Asa,
And he walked in the way of his father, Asa,
and he did not decline from it,
faciens quæ placita erant coram Domino.
doing the things that were pleasing before the Lord.
Yet truly, he did not take away the high places,
et adhuc populus non direxerat cor suum ad Dominum Deum patrum suorum.
and the people still had not directed their heart to the Lord, the God of their fathers.
Reliqua autem gestorum Josaphat priorum et novissimorum scripta sunt in verbis Jehu filii Hanani, quæ digessit in libros regum Israël.
But the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, the first and the last, have been written in the words of Jehu, the son of Hanani, which he digested into the books of the kings of Israel.
Post hæc iniit amicitias Josaphat rex Juda cum Ochozia rege Israël, cujus opera fuerunt impiissima.
After these things, Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, formed a friendship with Ahaziah, the king of Israel, whose works were very impious.
Et particeps fuit ut facerent naves quæ irent in Tharsis:
And he was a partner in the making of ships, which would go to Tarshish.
And they made the fleet at Eziongeber.
Prophetavit autem Eliezer filius Dodau de Maresa ad Josaphat,
Then Eliezer, the son of Dodavahu, from Mareshah,
saying: “Because you have made a pact with Ahaziah,
the Lord has struck your works,
and the ships have been broken,
and they have not been able to go to Tarshish.”
